newsitem.title: USA: Kansas unemployment falls to 3.9 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Kansas unemployment falls to 3.9 pct in April.

text.p: Kansas' unemployment rate dropped 3.9 percent in April from four percent in March, and the state set a new employment record for the second straight month, the state human resources department reported.
Favorable weather conditions allowed weather-dependent industries to fill new jobs in April, increasing the Kansas labor market strength, the department said in an announcement this week.
Kansas unemployment stood at 4.4 percent in April 1996 and 50,395 more jobs were reported in April this year than the year before, the department said.
Aircraft and parts industries reported 6,400 jobs gains in the last year with the services industry adding 10,600 and trade another 7,100, the department said.
